 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 244/2018 of PS Rohini North for offence under Section 498A/406/376/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have compromised the matrimonial disputes.
As regards offence under Section 376 IPC, it is submitted by both sides that vide order dated 30.10.2021, the concerned petitioner/accused was discharged.
3. For recording statements of parties, list before the concerned Joint Registrar on 09.02.2026.
This is a digitally signed order.
